pergunta: Which of Deborah`s family and friends have passed away?

focused_selection.text:
Session date: 4:06 pm on 23 January, 2023
[D1:4] Jolene: Why does it hold such special memories for you?
[D1:5] Deborah: It was full of memories, she passed away a few years ago. This is our last photo together.
[D1:6] Jolene: Sorry about your loss, Deb. My mother also passed away last year. This is my room in her house, I also have many memories there. Is there anything special about it you remember?
[D1:7] Deborah: My mom's house had a special bench near the window. She loved to sit there every morning and take in the view. I come to sit here sometimes, it helps me stay connected to her.
[...]
[D1:18] Jolene: Looking forward to the next chat!
Session date: 9:49 am on 27 January, 2023
[D2:1] Deborah: Hey Jolene, sorry to tell you this but my dad passed away two days ago. It's been really tough on us all - his sudden death left us all kinda shell-shocked. I'm trying to channel my grief by spending more time with family and cherishing the memories. These moments remind me to live life fully.
[D2:2] Jolene: Sorry to hear about your dad, Deborah. Losing a parent is tough - how's it going for you and your family?
[...]
[D2:4] Jolene: They were a beautiful couple!
[D2:5] Deborah: My husband and I are trying to be as good a family as my parents were!
[D2:6] Jolene: What do you value in your relationship?
[...]
[D2:12] Jolene: Where is it?
[D2:13] Deborah: That's my old home. I go there now and then for my mom, who passed away. Sitting in that spot by the window gives me peace.
[D2:14] Jolene: Must be great to have that place where you feel connected to her.

Session date: 9:03 pm on 9 February, 2023
[D5:17] Jolene: Stay safe!
Session date: 4:12 pm on 22 February, 2023
[D6:1] Jolene: Hey Deborah, totally buzzing! Had a great night out last night - dinner, and drinks with my friends. So glad I got to let my hair down. You?
[D6:2] Deborah: Sounds great, Jolene! I just visited this place and it was so calming. Nostalgic too.
[...]
Session date: 4:50 pm on 25 February, 2023
[D7:7] Jolene: We're not married yet but we've been together for three years. We're taking it slow and loving the ride. This ring on his hand is just a decoration, not a wedding ring.
[D7:8] Deborah: Sounds nice, Jolene. Enjoying the journey is the main thing. So, how did you two meet?
[D7:9] Jolene: We actually met in an engineering class in college and quickly became friends. It eventually blossomed into something more and it's been great!
[D7:10] Deborah: Wow, your relationship started from a strong friendship. Do you still enjoy working on engineering projects together?
[D7:11] Jolene: Yep, teaming up for these projects feels great! We get each other's struggles and both love it.
[D7:12] Deborah: Have yoga or meditation helped with any stress?
[D7:13] Jolene: Whenever I'm overwhelmed, I just take a break and do some breathing or meditate. It really helps me feel calmer and clearer, so I'm able to handle challenges more easily.
[D7:14] Deborah: It's been great to see your progress since we last chatted - keep it up!
[D7:15] Jolene: Thanks, Deb! Your support really means a lot. I'm gonna keep pushing forward and continue taking time for myself.

Session date: 2:14 pm on 3 September, 2023
[D24:3] Deborah: I was busy too - went to a community meetup last Friday. We shared stories and it was nice to feel how connected we are. It made me think about how important relationships are. How about you, how are things going in that area?
[D24:4] Jolene: I'm really thankful for my significant other right now. It's great to have someone encouraging my goals! How are things with your friends and family? Any updates on that front?
[D24:5] Deborah: Relationships with family and friends are so vital. My yoga pals have been my second family - we've held each other up through a lot. The other day I found this old photo. That was when I first started doing yoga. My mum was my biggest fan and source of motivation. She'd often come to my classes with me.
[D24:6] Jolene: Our loved ones sure are supportive! When I was 10, my parents got me that and it was the start of my passion for video games.
[...]
[D24:12] Jolene: Yeah! It's my way to de-stress and take a break from life.
[D24:13] Deborah: What's up this month? Anything fun happening for you?
[D24:14] Jolene: Got a lot of finals coming up this month, so I've been studying real hard. It's been quite stressful, but it'll be worth it in the end. Thinking about taking a trip somewhere to relax and recharge afterward.
[D24:15] Deborah: Good luck with it! Let me know if there's anything I can do to assist you.
Session date: 8:31 pm on 6 September, 2023
[D25:1] Jolene: Woohoo! I signed up for a meditation course at a retreat near a lake. Can't wait to share this experience with my partner and learn some new techniques. Sooo excited!
[D25:2] Deborah: That`s awesome! It looks so calm in the pic - I hope you enjoy your experience and learn some new techniques!
[D25:3] Jolene:  It's amazing how something so easy can make such a big difference to our health!
[D25:4] Deborah: Yep, it's become part of my routine now. Can't imagine my life without it.

Session date: 5:33 pm on 26 August, 2023
[D22:20] Jolene: Aww, that's adorable! What's the second one's name?
[D22:21] Deborah: Max! They bring lots of joy and peace to our home.
[D22:22] Jolene: How did you get them?
[D22:23] Deborah: Max is my mother's cat, I took him when my mother passed away.
[D22:24] Jolene: You're great for taming him. How did you get Luna?
[D22:25] Deborah: I took Luna from the shelter.
[D22:26] Jolene: It’s wonderful that you have become their loving owner!
[D22:27] Deborah: Yes, I really love cats, and they also need a home, love, and care! Moreover, Max is already old, he is 8 years old.
[D22:28] Jolene: How old is Luna?
[D22:29] Deborah: She is younger, she is 5 years old.
[D22:30] Jolene: I am proud of your action to tame these pets!
Session date: 11:46 am on 30 August, 2023
[D23:1] Jolene: Hey Deborah, how's it going? Guess what? Yesterday my partner and I got back from an awesome trip to Rio de Janeiro- we checked out some cool yoga classes.
[D23:2] Deborah: That yoga pose looks great. Must've been a cool experience for the two of you. What did the trip teach you?

Session date: 10:17 am on 20 September, 2023
[D30:1] Deborah: I had a great time at the music festival with my pals! The vibes were unreal and the music was magical. It was so freeing to dance and bop around. Music brings us together and helps us show our feelings. It reminds me of my mom and her soothing voice when she'd sing lullabies to me. Lucky to have those memories!
[D30:2] Jolene: Wow, festivals sound so fun! Here's me and my partner at one last year - had an awesome time! It's my way of expressing myself and getting away from all the stress of everyday life. Just got back from a trip with my partner - so cool!
[D30:3] Deborah: Wow, what a gorgeous shot! It looks so tranquil and serene. You two look very happy together. Trips create awesome memories that we can share. Where did you go on your trip and what's something you'll never forget?
[...]
[D30:10] Jolene: Yeah! I'm planning to get out in nature again next month. It's going to be great reconnecting with it!
[D30:11] Deborah:  Enjoy it! This photo made me think of a gorgeous blossom tree from near my home. Every spring, it was magical to watch it bloom.
[D30:12] Jolene: That sounds magical! How was it watching the tree bloom each spring?
[D30:13] Deborah: It was like admiring nature's artwork. It filled me with awe and made me appreciate the beauty of life. Even in tough times, there's hope for growth.
[D30:14] Jolene: This photo I took is a great visual representation of that idea. It reminds me that I can keep growing through any obstacles.
[D30:15] Deborah: It really captures resilience and strength. I love how you find inspiration in the small things.
[D30:16] Jolene: Thanks, Deborah! Appreciating those small things is important. It helps me remember that even when times are tough, there's always something positive to hang onto.
[D30:17] Deborah: It's a great habit. Thanks for reminding me!
[D30:18] Jolene: Sure Deb, it's great catching up. Keep on finding those beauties!
